Muster now supplies these keys in the Tenant Manifest tenant_identity with provenance; scripts/overrides-gate.mjs reads this file only when MX_ALLOW_OVERRIDES=1 and the TM lacks keys, and never takes initialPassword from it (the harness mints that per run into the Stamper environment). To be deleted (PLAN section 10). Original note: S1 (s1-mach) sim-only operator values until W1 retires overrides; derived from customers/s1-mach/customer.json (LOG-W0-sim section 9 item 9).

_notes.complianceRoleId: Entra built-in role template id for Compliance Administrator; whether the sim resolves it is to verify
_notes.roleDefId: Entra built-in role template id for Global Administrator (PIM eligible-assignment target); to verify on the sim
_notes.subscriptionId: placeholder GUID; the sim's Azure facade does not check subscription ids today; to verify
_notes.breakGlassUserId: the sim id of sim.user5 (no registry entry produced it in run 4; supplied directly, and a GET lookup entry is being added on the Stamper side)
_notes.baselineTemplateId: the simulator's seeded Intune security-baseline template (display name 'MDM Security Baseline for Windows 10 and later'); no registry entry names a template, so the id is supplied (CM.L2-3.4.1); a real tenant needs the operator to choose the template
_notes.runtime_captures: operatorUserId, cuiGroupId and namedLocationId are captured at run time from producing entries; the translator now orders producers before consumers (CAPTURE_DEPENDENCY edges)
